flows.title: Find a candidate
steps: Type into the search bar in the header, next to your avatar. Suggested candidates appear as you type, from both the active pipeline and the archive.
To narrow the search, use the filter chips below the search field with the operators AND, NOT and OR. The Resume chip searches only text parsed from resumes.
Pick a suggested candidate, or press Enter for a full page of results, sorted by last interaction with the most recent first.
For more criteria, click Advanced search at the bottom of the search menu.

flows.title: Consider a candidate for another job
steps: Go to the Candidates page and click a candidate's opportunity to open their profile.
In the Opportunities section of the profile, click + Add.
In the Consider for new job window, click Choose job... and select a posting. Closed and draft postings are not listed. To hold off on a job, select Create General Opportunity instead.
Click Create Opportunity. The new opportunity appears in the profile's Opportunities section, and whoever added it owns it.

flows.title: Refer a candidate
steps: Select the Referrals tab and click Refer Candidate. Under Referrals, the Jobs tab also has Refer Candidate beside each posting.
At the top of the referral form, select at least one job posting and at most three. A posting published only internally cannot be chosen.
If you have the candidate's resume, drag the file onto the form or click the upload file button. Lever fills in matching fields from it.
Fill in the form's fields and the Your recommendation section, then click Submit Referral.
